label: Minimum
blurb: Photoshop's Minimum: every pixel takes the darkest value around it, so dark areas spread and bright details shrink or vanish. Use it to thicken dark lines and outlines, spread a matte or close small light gaps. Square spreads in a box; Round spreads in a circle (built from eight directions). By brightness keeps each pixel's colour together instead of taking the darkest red, green and blue separately.
